fields.biography:
Anja Glauch is a seasoned marketing professional with extensive expertise in digital strategy. She spent seven years leading the SEO & Social team at IG Group in London, where she centralized organic search strategies, managed content direction, and improved search engine visibility. Prior to IG Group, Anja held a strategic role at Groupon, establishing a growth channel and collaborating with global leadership to enhance performance. 

As CMO, Anja oversees SEO, advertisements, campaign planning, event planning, and social media management and so much more. Her leadership skills and digital marketing acumen are instrumental in driving our marketing initiatives.

fields.postContent:
## 🌟 2025: A Year of Exciting Possibilities with Search Guard! 🌟

As 2025 unfolds, we’re energized by the opportunities ahead, and we want to bring you along for the ride. With fresh product updates, exciting partnerships, and a packed event schedule, there’s so much to look forward to this year. Let's take a moment to reflect on some of your favorite content from 2024 and share what’s on the horizon for Search Guard!

## The Best of 2024: Your Favorite Content

Looking back on 2024, we’re proud of the content we created together. Here are the blogs that stood out to our readers, based on both traffic and engagement:

### **Top Blogs by Traffic:**

1.[** Writing Kibana Plugins**](https://www.search-guard.com/blog/writing-kibana-plugins-1/)  
   *An essential guide for developers looking to extend Kibana’s functionality with custom plugins.*

2.[ **Elasticsearch Painless Alerting Primer**](https://www.search-guard.com/blog/elasticsearch-painless-alerting-primer/)  
   *Step-by-step instructions for configuring alerting in Elasticsearch with Painless scripts for advanced use cases.*

3.[**10 Tips on How to Improve Your Elasticsearch Indexing Performance**](https://www.search-guard.com/blog/10-tips-on-how-to-improve-your-elasticsearch-indexing-performance/)  
   *Proven strategies for boosting Elasticsearch performance and streamlining the indexing process.*

4.[**John Draper & Captain Crunch**](https://www.search-guard.com/blog/john-draper-captin-crunch/)  
   *A fascinating history of John Draper, aka Captain Crunch, and his role in early hacker culture.*

5.[**Kibana OpenID Keycloak**](https://www.search-guard.com/blog/kibana-openid-keycloak/)  
   *How to integrate Kibana with OpenID and Keycloak for secure, centralized user authentication.*

### **Top Blogs by Engagement:**

1.[**Search Guard Alerting vs ElastAlert**](https://www.search-guard.com/blog/search-guard-alerting-vs-elastalert/)  
   *A comprehensive comparison of Search Guard Alerting and ElastAlert to help you choose the right tool for your alerting needs.*

2.[**Search Guard vs Search Guard FLX**](https://www.search-guard.com/blog/search-guard-vs-search-guard-flx/)  
   *A side-by-side analysis of Search Guard and Search Guard FLX, two robust solutions for securing your Elasticsearch and OpenSearch environments.*

3.[**Melba Roy Mouton**](https://www.search-guard.com/blog/melba-roy-mouton/)  
   *A tribute to Melba Roy Mouton, a pioneering woman in computing and a key player in NASA's space missions.*

4.[**Hall of Fame: Karl Koch**](https://www.search-guard.com/blog/hall-of-fame-karl-koch/)  
   *An exploration of Karl Koch’s legacy in the world of hacking, tracing his influence on the digital revolution.*

5.[**Enterprise Alerting with Elasticsearch & Kibana (Free Version)**](https://www.search-guard.com/blog/enterprise-alerting-elasticsearch-kibana-free/)  
   *A practical guide to setting up enterprise-level alerting using Elasticsearch and Kibana with a focus on free solutions.*

## Where to Find Us in 2025

This year, we’re bringing our expertise to some of the most significant events in the tech space. Here’s where we’ll be meeting up with our community and sharing knowledge:

- **Buzzwords Berlin:** 
Join us for a deep dive into the cutting-edge trends in search, security, and scalability.
- **Stackconf:** 
Discover the latest in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and how Search Guard integrates with modern tech stacks.
- **OSMC (Open Source Monitoring Conference):** 
We're excited to return to OSMC to learn, share, and enhance Open Source monitoring techniques with you.
- **WeAreDevelopers:** 
We’ll be exploring the intersection of development, security, and innovation with some of the brightest minds in the industry.

We’re eager to meet you in person—mark your calendars and get ready to engage with us at these key events!

## Our Partnership with GlobalGiving

At Search Guard, we believe in more than just securing data and infrastructure—we’re committed to making a meaningful impact on the world. Our collaboration with **GlobalGiving** allows us to empower our employees and community to contribute to important social and environmental causes. Through this initiative, we provide opportunities for donations and volunteer efforts, fostering a culture of responsibility and shared purpose.

We’re proud to align our mission to secure not only technology but a better future for communities around the globe. Together, we can make a real difference!

## Stay Connected

Want to stay in the loop? [Join our mailing list](https://search-guard.com/newsletter/) to receive the latest product updates, event announcements, and insightful blog posts straight to your inbox.

Here’s to a fantastic year ahead! We’re excited to have you along for the ride and thank you for being an essential part of the Search Guard journey.

fields.postContent:
As we enter what’s known in Germany as the "5th season"—the time when everything slows down a bit, family and friends take center stage, and we wrap up the year—it's the perfect moment to pause, reflect, and plan for the future. For us at Search Guard, this year has been about resilience, adaptability, and most importantly, the power of community.

## A Year of Adaptation and Growth

The pace of change in the world seems to grow faster each year. As businesses and individuals scramble to keep up with evolving technologies and challenges, it can often feel overwhelming. Yet, for us at Search Guard, it’s also been a year of progress, building on a strong foundation of security, trust, and community.

We’ve been able to consistently provide our customers with reliable, trusted solutions even in the face of uncertainty. Many businesses around us have struggled, some even closing their doors, but we have continued to grow and innovate, thanks in large part to our loyal users and team.

## A History of Milestones and Innovation

Search Guard has always been about meeting the security needs of the open-source world, and this year has seen many milestones that reinforce our mission. Since our inception in 2016, we’ve worked tirelessly to offer the most secure solutions, constantly improving as new challenges arise.

Some of the most important milestones in our journey include:
- 2012: Launching Search Guard to provide top-notch security for Elasticsearch.
- 2020: Founding Eliatra, which allowed us to broaden our reach and capabilities.
- 2021: Partnering with OpenSearch to continue pushing innovation in the search and analytics space.
- 2024: Eliatra becoming a founding member of the OpenSearch Software Foundation, marking a new chapter of collaboration and open-source leadership.
These milestones are a testament to the dedication and vision of the Search Guard team, and most importantly, the trust of our customers. We wouldn’t be where we are today without you.

## The Power of Community

As Bob Dylan wisely said:
“For the loser now,
Will be later to win,
For the times they are a-changin’.”

Change is inevitable, and we embrace it, especially with the support of our community. This year, we've seen the true strength of our collective efforts. It’s clear that no journey is ever truly a solo endeavor—community is what helps us face challenges, adapt, and thrive.

At Search Guard, our growth is deeply tied to the relationships we’ve built with our customers, employees, and partners. We cannot do this alone, and we know that the best achievements are the ones we share together. We’re grateful for your continued trust and support.

## Looking Ahead to 2025

As we move into the new year, we are filled with optimism for what lies ahead. We look forward to the challenges and opportunities 2025 will bring, knowing that with your continued support, there’s nothing we can’t overcome. By sticking together, we can continue to make an impact, innovate, and lead in the open-source community.

Thank you for being part of our journey. Together, we’ll make the next year even better than the last.

fields.title: Introducing Search Guard FLX 3.0: The Future of Enterprise Security for Elasticsearch
fields.htmlDescription: We’re excited to unveil Search Guard FLX 3.0 – the most powerful and flexible security suite yet for your Elasticsearch deployment.
fields.author: Jochen Kressin

fields.htmlDescription: Jochen Kressin is a Serial Entrepreneur and the Co-Founder of Search Guard, Eliatra and go-ffwd.
fields.shortDescription: Jochen Kressin is the Founder and CEO of Search Guard and Eliatra. Search Guard is one of the first security plugins for Elasticsearch and Kibana, so he has year-long experience providing security solutions for this ecosystem. With the advent of ODFE and finally OpenSearch, Jochen Co-founded Eliatra. Eliatra specializes in support, services, products and solutions for OpenSearch and is an official partner and contributor to the project.
fields.biography:
I am a seasoned CTO, IT architect, and serial entrepreneur with over 18 years of experience in leading high-performance, multi-national teams and driving innovative IT solutions across diverse industries. My expertise spans distributed systems, high-traffic platforms, and open-source technologies, with a strong emphasis on security, scalability, and business alignment.

As Co-Founder and Director at Eliatra, Co-Founder & CEO at go-ffwd GmbH, and CEO & CTO of Search Guard, I’ve led organizations specializing in search analytics, cybersecurity, and technological innovation. My entrepreneurial ventures include founding Symlink GmbH and contributing as an interim CTO at Künstlerfreunde GbR and ShopReader UG, where I drove technological strategy and product development.

Earlier in my career, I held leadership roles at StayFriends GmbH as Director of New Business and Principal IT Architect, and served as a Software Architect at artnology GmbH, delivering large-scale software systems. My background also includes experience as a J2EE Consultant and Developer of server-side solutions.

Academically, I hold an MBA in Information Technology from the University of Potsdam and a Dipl.-Ing. in Computer Science from FH Offenburg. 

Passionate about disruptive technologies, digital innovation, and scalable architectures, I am driven to bridge the gap between technical excellence and strategic business goals. I thrive in environments where technology meets entrepreneurship, and I am always eager to collaborate on projects that push the boundaries of what's possible in the digital landscape.

Let’s connect to discuss technology, innovation, or future collaborations!

fields.postContent:
Welcome to the future of enterprise security. We’re excited to unveil Search Guard FLX 3.0 – the most powerful and flexible security suite yet for your Elasticsearch deployment. Packed with new features, this release is designed to make securing your Elasticsearch clusters easier, more efficient, and more scalable than ever before.

<video/>

## New Features in Search Guard FLX 3.0
### Data Streams and Aliases: First-Class Citizens

One of the standout features of Search Guard FLX 3.0 is the addition of Data Streams and Aliases as first-class citizens. This means managing time-series data and creating flexible data access patterns is now more streamlined and intuitive. Whether you're working with logs, metrics, or other types of time-series data, you can now create security policies that align perfectly with how you store and access data. This seamless integration makes your Elasticsearch deployment easier to manage and more secure.

### Improved Signals with Scalable Configuration

Search Guard has always been known for its powerful alerting capabilities, and in version 3.0, we've taken it a step further. Signals now come with new configuration options designed for easy scaling. As your Elasticsearch deployment grows, so does your ability to monitor and act on critical events – without any hiccups. Our new features allow you to scale your alerting and notification system as you scale your infrastructure, ensuring that no alert goes unnoticed.

### Kibana Dark Mode Support

For all you night owls out there – we’ve heard you! We’re thrilled to announce that Search Guard now fully supports Kibana dark mode. Whether you're working in low-light environments or just prefer the darker aesthetic, Search Guard ensures that every screen, every menu, and every detail of your Kibana interface is optimized for low-light use. Say goodbye to eye strain and hello to better visibility with our sleek dark mode design.

### Streamlined Error Handling

Time spent troubleshooting is time lost, which is why we’ve revamped our error handling in Search Guard FLX 3.0. With clear, actionable error messages, you’ll be able to identify and resolve issues in record time. No more guesswork or frustration—just straightforward solutions that help you get back on track quickly. We’ve made troubleshooting as easy as possible, so you can focus on what matters most: securing your Elasticsearch cluster.

### Transparent and Simple Licensing

We get it — enterprise software licensing can be confusing and full of hidden costs. That’s why at Search Guard, we’ve made our licensing model refreshingly simple. We believe security shouldn’t come with surprises or complicated math, and with Search Guard, it doesn’t.

## Search Guard Community Edition: Free & Open Source

Looking for powerful Elasticsearch security that won’t break the bank? Meet Search Guard Community Edition – completely free and open source. Yes, you read that right. Free as in free beer, licensed under Apache 2.

No catch. No hidden costs. No limitations. What's included? Everything you need for enterprise-grade security, including:

- Robust security essentials for Elasticsearch
- Signals Alerting for proactive monitoring
- Automated Index Management for easy maintenance

Search Guard Community Edition brings enterprise security to everyone, regardless of budget.

## Search Guard Enterprise & Compliance Editions

If you need more, we’ve got you covered. Meet the Search Guard Enterprise and Compliance Editions— our flagship products built for the modern enterprise. These editions come with a simple, straightforward, and fair licensing model: you pay a flat fee per production cluster. That's it.

- Want to add more users? No problem.
- Data growing fast? We’ve got that covered.
- Need all security features? They’re included.

With Search Guard, you scale your cluster without scaling your costs.

## Getting Started with Search Guard

Why wait to protect your Elasticsearch deployment when you can start right now? Getting started with Search Guard is easy:

- Download the free Community Edition.
- Run a simple installation command.
- Secure your cluster in minutes.

No risk. No commitment. No credit card needed. Just enterprise-grade security at your fingertips.

Your data deserves the best protection. With Search Guard, you can rest easy knowing your Elasticsearch deployment is secure, scalable, and simple to manage.

Download Search Guard today and experience the future of Elasticsearch security!
